sources.author: Blue-Autumn UR7e experiment
sources.contract: v0..6 float32 millimetres in the corresponding standard DH frame. f0..6 int32 indexed triangles, c0..6 per-face uint8 RGB, s0..6 per-face original STEP solid entity. Identical NPZ for animation and geometry screening.
sources.method: Exact outer CLOSED_SHELL and its original analytic surfaces selected from each STEP solid. Original STEP units and assembly occurrence transforms retained. OpenCASCADE STL tessellation, welded coincident rim coordinates on 1e-6 mm grid, then meshoptimizer vertex-preserving quadric simplification per body. No generated proxy hulls or capsules.
sources.limitations: Only explicit internal void boundaries were omitted. Recesses and through holes belong to the outer shell. Surface simplification is approximate. Inspect each solid's edge topology before using closed-volume containment. Sample diagnostics compare against the finer tessellation, outside/inside segment paths and continuous collision are unverified. The original base includes a fixed cable/connector, not deformable cable mechanics. Only the bare robot is in this file. Mounted tool, load, calibration and nearby equipment require separate models.
